title: C16 URL-as-source-of-truth state

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: Filters, sort, and pagination are encoded entirely in searchParams (no client store), and the server component reads searchParams to render the filtered result set (awaited per Next.js 16).

A URL with applied filters is shareable/restorable: opening it directly in a new tab reproduces the same filtered state and the filter UI reflects the URL parameters (QA functional: URL-as-state filters are shareable and restorable from a direct URL load).
Filter updates are debounced before being written to the URL so rapid input does not spam navigation/history.
NOTES.md explains why URL-as-state is chosen here over a client store and the tradeoffs (shareability/SSR-readability vs URL verbosity).

The c16 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via local _lib over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
